titlealts.navtitle: CONVERT LEGACY HIVE PARQUET UTC TIMESTAMPS

conbody.p:
CONVERT_LEGACY_HIVE_PARQUET_UTC_TIMESTAMPS query option
The CONVERT_LEGACY_HIVE_PARQUET_UTC_TIMESTAMPS query option controls whether Impala converts INT96 timestamps from UTC to local time when reading Parquet files written by Parquet Java (parquet-mr), including files written by Hive.

Hive normalizes INT96 timestamps to UTC when writing Parquet files. Set this option to TRUE to read the same values that Hive returns. The option does not affect writes or INT64 timestamps, and has no effect when the query time zone is UTC.

The TIMEZONE query option selects the local time zone; if unset, Impala uses the coordinator's default time zone. To reproduce Hive's values, select the time zone used when Hive wrote the file. For the conversion method, see .
This option replaces the deprecated --convert_legacy_hive_parquet_utc_timestamps startup flag, which still sets the option's default.
